reason: We already have an inverter at home, so if we ever get a machine I would buy an ordinary semi-automatic for about ten or twelve thousand and run it on that. Paying almost twenty-two thousand just for a battery inside the washer makes no sense when the battery is already in my house.
objection: I am paying twice for backup power. My inverter can already carry a washer, and only 2 loads per charge from a battery I cannot see or check worries me, because after a few years it will need replacing and that will cost money again.
would_change_my_mind: If it cost about the same as a normal semi-automatic, around ₹13,000, so the battery came almost free, or if a neighbour showed me it works through our long evening cuts without touching the inverter.
